We need go through each story. Need decide. Let's parse all.

Criterion Unambiguous: avoids terms/abstractions leading to multiple materially different interpretations. Violation when vague, underspecified, overloaded, unclear terms allow materially different requirements interpretations. Do not flag harmless stylistic variation.

Need evaluate every story. Some obvious problematic: BC-004 "very clear map" vague. BC-005 "edit my training node myself" and "links to slides" maybe ambiguous. BC-007 "attendend, refunded, no show" typo but statuses maybe okay? "admin view" maybe broad. BC-010 "tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration/cancellation workflow exists" vague/underspecified. BC-011 "if there is a schedule feature on the site" uncertain conditional, vague. BC-013 long ambiguous. BC-014 "WTF is happening" obviously vague. BC-015 detailed but maybe "Logo, title..." not ambiguous. BC-016 "clearly marked" maybe vague? But list specified. BC-019 "find out where coding lounge is and what time it is open" maybe clear. BC-024 "venues" maybe okay. BC-031 "link BADCamp attendees to my sponsorship page" maybe ambiguous "link attendees"? BC-033 okay. BC-037 "sponsor a summit that matches my brand" vague "matches my brand". BC-046 "specific details on summits" vague; but maybe okay? BC-048 okay. BC-049 "all long-form content" vague. BC-054 assign room to time slot and location maybe ambiguous. BC-055 okay. BC-059 anonymoususer receive notification when sessions evaluated? Might be anonymous? But unambiguous? maybe "notification" vague? BC-064 personalize sponsorship page vague. BC-065 list summits include when they are. BC-067 easily find a link vague "easily". BC-068 clear. BC-069 "session information" vague. Let's systematically examine.

Need output 69. Need maybe classify many as violation due vague terms. But need avoid overflagging benign. Let's create table.

- "view a list of sponsors" clear enough. No violation. Ambiguity? "sponsors" maybe list of sponsor orgs? But not materially different? likely no violation.

- "email all the trainers at once from the website" clear. "It is easier to use" not criterion maybe benefit. no violation.

"very clear" is nonfunctional subjective; could mean schematic? But likely not materially different requirements? It could lead to ambiguous design (what counts clear?) but maybe unambiguous enough? Actually "where buildings and rooms are" is clear. "clear" is quality adjective but not multiple material req? Maybe no violation. But could be "clearly marked" etc. We'll consider.

But "training node" in Drupal context (BADCamp) maybe clear? Could allow different interpretations: edit all training content? "links to slides" in benefit maybe additional requirement but ambiguous. I think violation: "edit my training node" + "links to slides" underspecified/unclear. Especially "links to slides" not connected. Evidence: "edit my training node myself ... and links to slides".
